result.summary: This PR moves BSD SDK (NetBSD/FreeBSD/OpenBSD) download-and-extract logic out of the CI image build step and into a separate script run after the container starts, and caches the SDK archives independently of the image build cache. It also unifies how cache source/destination paths are defined and mounted in ci/test/02_run_container.py for both Docker and host-folder modes. The stated goal is to avoid re-downloading large SDK archives whenever the image-build cache is invalidated, reducing load on upstream archive mirrors and CI flakiness from those downloads.
result.problem: CI jobs sometimes need to re-download BSD SDK archives when the image-build cache is missed, which can delay or fail jobs and adds unnecessary load on external archive servers; this affects CI maintainers and anyone waiting on BSD CI jobs to complete.

open_concerns: maflcko suggested an alternative of adding fallback mirrors (as depends does) instead of separate caching, and asked whether there were CI logs showing actual download failures; the author had none to point to, weakening the failure-severity claim though the redundant-download rationale stands.
PR needs a rebase (mergeable_state dirty, Needs rebase label) and conflicts with open PR #35754 which also touches SDK verification/caching.
